title: What’s the deal with the airplanes?
content: The dreams I’ve been having lately are about airplanes that had very specific times when they could fly. If they tried to fly outside of these times, things would go wrong. (Not entirely sure what) Because of this, they all had to land at the airport to avoid any issues. The sky also has a very dark and ominous feel to it. Wondering if anybody else has had similar dreams to this in their mall world?
